skill.summary: Compresses a reading insight into a reusable personal knowledge note with context, links, and retrieval cues.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Personal Knowledge Capsule skill.

- Compresses reading insights into reusable personal knowledge notes with context, links, and retrieval cues.
- Supports workflows like Zettelkasten, atomic notes, and personal knowledge systems.
- Guides users to capture ideas, source context, personal relevance, and storage preferences.
- Ensures outputs include title, core idea, relevant context, personal connection, and retrieval cues.
- Incorporates strong safety guidelines to protect intellectual property and user responsibility.
